simple.meaning: עָשָׁן (ʻâshân) is a Hebrew object word meaning “smoke , literally or figuratively ( vapor , dust , anger ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 15:17. The surrounding context includes death, kingship, city, mountain, wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָשָׁן (H6227) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עָשָׁן (ʻâshân) / H6227 is traced through Genesis 15:17, Exodus 19:18, Joshua 8:20, Joshua 8:21 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.
All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. The people who fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.
When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned back and killed the men of Ai.
Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.
But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.
Smoke went up out of his nostrils.
“I will not keep silence concerning his limbs,
He bowed the heavens also, and came down.
But let the righteous be glad.
My heart is blighted like grass, and withered,
As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes,
Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.
The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men,
Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
It won’t be quenched night nor day.

definitions.short: smoke , literally or figuratively ( vapor , dust , anger )
definitions.full: H6227. ashan I. עָשָׁן noun masculine Exod 19:16 smoke ; — absolute ׳ע Judg 20:38 +, construct עֲשַׁן Josh 8:20-21 , עֶ֫שֶׁן Exod 19:18 ; suffix עֲשָׁנוֺ 19:18 , עֲשָׁנָהּ Isa 34:10 ; — 1. a. of burning city Josh 8:20 ; 8:21 ; Judges 20:88; Judg 20:40 , compare Nahum 2:14; heralding a foe Isa 14:31 . b. in figurative of destruction of Israel Isa 9:17 , Edom 34:10 . c. simile of dust-cloud Song 3:6 ; of transitoriness Hosea 13:3 ; Isa 51:6 ; Psa 37:20 (reading ׳כֶּע , as ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ), 68:3 ; 102:4 ; simile of the unpleasant, Prov 10:26 . d. breath of crocodile Job 41:12 . 2. a. attending theoph. , ע ׳תַּנּוּר Gen 15:17 ; of mountain Exod 19:18 , compare simile ׳כְּע הַכִּבְשָׁן 19:18 ; Isa 6:4 , also 4:5 ; Joel 3:3 . b. of God's anger , ׳ע בְּאַמּוֺ 2Sam 22:9 = Psa 18:9 ; so probably also Isa 65:5 .
